prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Chinese woman — the personification of the city of Beijing — one woman who IS Beijing as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cute, bright-eyed sweetness; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; softly rounded face that still tapers to a small chin; eyes on the larger side of natural — almond-shaped eyes of natural size, outer eye corners drooping downward; straight brows of natural fullness; a nose with a soft, rounded tip, of natural size; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size; hazel eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; a bob with blunt straight bangs; royal-blue hair.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a small closed-lip smile that reaches the eyes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: gaslamp-fantasy dress of a storybook steam city cut to the outfit silhouette below — fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather with polished brass buttons, buckles and clockwork filigree, a little gear-and-crystal brooch; clean, elegant and adventurous, gleaming brass and glass, never sooty or rusty.
City motif: a fitted, high-collared gown cut like a qipao in white silk painted with cobalt-blue porcelain scrolls, closed with brass frog buttons down one side, its hem and cuffs banded in brass that steps up and down like the battlements of the long mountain wall; at her hip a little red-lacquered drum on a brass chain.
World marks on her: polished brass buttons and buckles; clockwork filigree; little gears and glass lenses as jewelry; tinted brass goggles worn as a hair ornament; a pocket watch on a fine chain; a ribbon of white steam curling around her; warm gaslight glinting on brass; feathers and silk ribbons; fine leather gloves; delicate brass instruments clipped to her belt.
Silhouette: a fitted bodice with visible brass boning and a gown hemmed with little gear ornaments — clockwork detailing traces her shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: porcelain cobalt blue, porcelain white and polished brass, with lacquer red only on the drums and gates — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a red-lacquered drum beater capped in polished brass, a silk tassel swinging from its handle; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her elegant outfit shows skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a low neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs under a short hem or above tall laced boots; the brass ornaments stay neat and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy Beijing on a soft golden evening: narrow hutong lanes of grey-brick courtyard houses with red-lacquered gates, gas lamps and red silk lanterns glowing side by side; at the end of the lane the tall two-storey drum tower and, behind it, the grey-walled bell tower with its green glazed roof; a brass steam rickshaw puffing clean white steam past the willows; out on the palace lake a pavilion-boat of white marble with brass paddlewheels turning in soft steam; silk kites and airships with lantern-shaped balloons drifting over the golden palace roofs in the distance.
This card: on the upper floor of the drum tower at dusk, rows of great red-lacquered drums on carved stands around her, brass clockwork gears turning in the painted rafters and the gaslit grey roofs of the hutong lanes spread below.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
